|lore=Able leader and captain of the Avenger. Was given his command by Admiral Ozzel. Treated with suspicion by Darth Vader and the Emperor, who distrust Ozzel's close advisors.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Avenger, that starship is also immune to attrition &lt; 4. You may re-target applicable Utinni Effects to Needa. If in a battle where you choose to forfeit characters, you must forfeit Needa first.
|errata_history=This is the Players Committee's image marked E, present in the repository's 8 July 2018 import. The image may have been made earlier. It gives a power bonus to anything Needa pilots. Its final sentence says to forfeit Needa first if choosing to forfeit characters. The [[:File:Dagobah-D-Captain-Needa-PC-E2-2022-12-23.png|23 December 2022 image]] replaces that sentence with the restriction on forfeiting other non-hit characters. Source: [[:File:Dagobah-D-captainneeda-E-2018-07-08.gif|published face]].
